messages:
maria: Heads-up — started onboarding Velociprobe-v1 (384-d, baseline fp16) against wiki-holdout. Quick numbers: recall@1 0.762, recall@5 0.834, recall@10 0.873. Running int8 quant (dynamic) next to compare.
jon: nice, thanks. can you share the eval command and dataset split briefly?
maria: sure — using holdout_2025_07 (50k queries). eval script:```python
# run_eval.py snippet
from evallib import load_model, eval_recall
model = load_model('velociprobe-v1', precision='fp16')
res = eval_recall(model, 'holdout_2025_07', ks=[1,5,10])
print(res)
```
li: any latency numbers on fp16? throughput?
maria: p99 latency ~28ms on our standard batch=1 infra (A10x2 pod). throughput ~850 qps with microbatching at batch=8.
jon: ok cool. results from int8?
maria: int8 (dynamic quant via onnxruntime) dropped recall@10 to 0.815, recall@1 to 0.71. embedding L2 variance up ~1.8x for long-tail queries. UMAP shows a handful of small clusters shifting.
li: that's larger than i'd expect. did you try per-channel quant (per-channel int8) and symmetric scaling?
maria: tried per-channel per-tensor hybrid: small improvement — recall@10 up to 0.829 but still ~4.4% absolute loss vs fp16.
jon: can you paste the minimal diff of the embeddings for a failing query example?
maria: pasted sample diff:```diff
- fp16: [0.12, -0.03, 0.98, ...]
+ int8: [0.11, -0.01, 0.94, ...]
Delta L2: 0.18
```
li: hmm. looks like top-k neighbor reorder for ~2.6% of queries. might be sensitive to normalization + whitening. did you run the pre-whiten step used in our production pipeline?
maria: initially I skipped whitening to mirror baseline tests. rerunning with l2-normalize + PCA-whiten(t=256) now. will post results in 10m.
ops-bot: :white_check_mark: job/velociprobe-int8-whiten-retry completed (success) — results: recall@10 0.862, recall@1 0.738.
jon: wow whitening recovered most of the gap. good signal. can we add this to onboarding playbook: int8 + mandatory whitening + per-channel quant by default?
li: agree. also add a small target: <=1.5% recall@10 loss vs fp16 for release. otherwise block and escalate to quant-engineing.
maria: filing a short PR for playbook and attaching eval notebook + UMAP snapshots. gist: https://gist.github.com/redwood/velociprobe-int8-onboard-logs
jon: thanks — can you also run a cluster-level silhouette score and nearest-neighbor ID-flip rate? want numbers to compare across models.
maria: will include silhouette + idflip in final log. current plan: (1) run int8+per-channel+whiten, (2) compute recall@k, id-flip %, silhouette, (3) run small ablation on PCA dims (128/256/384). posting results when done.
li: perfect. tag me when PR is up. :thumbsup:
